verdict: Mango is easier to control. Fewer calories, very little fat, and hard to overeat.
why: 1 mango is an estimated 200 kcal, 4 ulas (seeds) of durian an estimated 260 kcal.
Durian has 6 g fat, mango only 1 g.
Protein is the same, 3 g. Neither helps much with feeling full.
Durian is very easy to overeat. When a whole fruit is opened for everyone, 4 ulas can become 10 without you noticing.
when_a: Durian is okay during durian season with family. Set a limit of 3-4 ulas, eat slowly and enjoy it.
when_b: Mango is okay as dessert or an afternoon snack. Even half a mango is sweet enough.
tip: When you eat durian, cut down on rice at the meal before, and don't eat it when you're very hungry.

faq.q: Can I eat durian while trying to lose weight?
faq.a: Yes. Durian is not banned. Count it as part of that day's calories and control the number of ulas.

faq.q: Mango is very sweet, is that okay?
faq.a: Okay. The sweetness comes from natural sugar, and fruit has fibre. If the mango is big, share it or eat half.
